title: DC-area forecast: Blue skies with cooler highs
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: Partly sunny this afternoon as highs reach the mid- to upper 80s while decreases slightly
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Partly sunny this afternoon as highs reach the mid- to upper 80s while decreases slightly.

What’s next? Turning less humid tonight. Highs climb to near 90 on a sunny Wednesday with moderate humidity, before storm chances return Thursday and Friday amid moderate to high humidity.

Today’s daily digit — 7/10: Be thankful with this tiny time out from daily showers and storms. And enjoy the sunnier skies, slightly lower afternoon humidity, and warm 80s. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Tuesday): Heading to highs in the mid- to upper 80s this afternoon. Still pretty muggy but humidity may drop a little during the afternoon with a breeze from the northwest at 5 to 10 mph. A very slight chance of a late-day shower or storm exists. Confidence: High

Tonight: Mostly clear and turning less humid with lows from the mid-60s in the suburbs to the mid-70s in the city. Winds continue from the northwest at 5 to 10 mph. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Wednesday): Partly to mostly sunny and a bit hotter. Highs reach for the upper 80s to low 90s with moderate humidity. Winds shift to come from the west and southwest from 5 to 10 mph. Confidence: High

Tomorrow night: Partly cloudy and moderately muggy with lows in the upper 60s to mid-70s. Confidence: High

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

The chance of scattered showers and storms returns Thursday with moderate to high humidity. Highs head toward the upper 80s under mostly cloudy skies. The rain could continue into Thursday night with muggy lows in the low to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium

Friday isn't as warm, but we may still contend with moderate mugginess, clouds at times, and scattered showers and thunderstorms. Highs reach the low to mid-80s. Friday night keeps more showers and storms around with lows in the mid-60s to the low 70s. Confidence: Medium

Our second-to-last weekend of August brings partly to mostly cloudy skies on Saturday with highs in the 80s, and more scattered showers and storms. They may linger Saturday night with lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Sunday has a shot to clear out a bit with partly to mostly sunny skies and lower humidity. Highs are in the low 80s, but clouds, humidity, and shower chances could linger a bit longer. Confidence: Low-Medium

Next week should see highs in the 80s with lower humidity Monday and Tuesday, before it turns warmer and more humid later in the week when the chance of showers and storms return.

DC weather history for August 18

Heavy rain from Hurricane Diane in 1955 flooded rivers and roads, while in 2002 an intense heat wave pushed temperatures to a record 98 degrees during a prolonged stretch of 90s.
